$comment: Edit this file at any time. The memory service re-reads it from disk on every request, so the running n8n workflow picks up changes without a restart or a redeploy.

offer.what_it_does: turns a name, company or LinkedIn URL into a verified work email or direct dial through an API and a Google Sheets add-on
offer.frictionless_offer: I can run your last 200 exported leads through it and send back the enriched file — no call, no signup, nothing to install.
offer.proof_point: Costs 10 credits per LinkedIn-profile-to-email lookup; a 5,000-credit month is $49.
offer.cta: want a 2-minute backend video teardown of how the matching works?

icp.notes: Best fit is a team already running outbound that is paying per-enrichment somewhere else, or stitching enrichment together by hand in a spreadsheet.

soft_notes: Skip anyone whose signal is them selling a competing enrichment or lead-gen product — they are a vendor, not a buyer.
Skip pure agencies with no in-house outbound motion of their own.
Skip a lead whose only signal is a generic like or follow with no stated context.

copywriting.tone: Engineering-grade peer-to-peer. You are one operator writing to another operator about a system. Concrete nouns, no adjectives doing persuasion work.
banned_phrases: hope this email finds you well
Let me know if this resonates
rules: Sentence 1: an analytical observation drawn from the actual Trigify signal — name the specific thing they did or said. No compliment, no flattery, no 'I saw that you'.
Sentence 2: the frictionless offer from offer.frictionless_offer, stated as a fact about what you will do, not as a request.
Sentence 3: the low-pressure CTA from offer.cta, ending in a question mark.
Never invent a metric, a headcount, a funding round or a customer name that is not in the supplied data.
Subject line: 2 to 5 lowercase words, no colon, no question mark, no company name in title case, reads like an internal note.

learning.note: Below the threshold there is not enough signal to pattern-match on, so the agent falls back to the ICP block alone. Above it, the agent must justify the lookalike match.

signal.note: A signal type outside this list is still processed, but the agent is told the signal is unrecognised and must weigh it more conservatively.
